g.text: FICTITIOUS DESIGN • MCP integration test • 01 Oct 2026
180 people • Montréal HQ / Québec distribution / private cloud / remote work
Two independent circuits • encrypted site links • identity-led remote access
Test WAN addresses only • outbound NAT at each firewall
Overview links summarize sites. Detailed links remain local to their own panel.
Gateways on firewall HA: 10.40.<VLAN>.1/24 • core/access switches are L2 trunks
ACCESS SEGMENTS / INTER-VLAN POLICY ENFORCED BY FIREWALL HA
SERVER ZONE • V70 / HA COMPUTE + SHARED STORAGE
V80 DMZ, V90 backup and V10 management traverse tagged L2 trunks; all zone access is filtered at HA.
Same segmentation model • restricted VPN routes • private service addresses
V60 → named ERP + print endpoints only.
Illustrative architecture • private RFC1918 addressing • no real infrastructure
GUEST: internet-only NAT; deny private prefixes.
IoT: deny lateral access; allow named services.
BACKUP: isolated V90; deny user access;
immutable offsite copy with separate identity.
Default deny between VLANs; explicit app rules.
Monitor HA, uplinks, VPN, DNS and backup jobs.
Quarterly restore tests; patch standby first.
Cloud DB accepts app-tier traffic only.
BRANCH 10.50.0.0/16 • same VLAN numbering; active segments 10/20/30/40/60.
